text:
Mira: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about API/Console/Optimize timelines. need final owners and gating checks so marketing/docs can lock dates.
Ana: owners recap: adaptive-batching -> Jamal/eng-runtime, console cost breakdown -> Lin/billing+console, Optimize suggestions UI -> Priya/optimize.
Mira: concrete dates requested please.
Jamal: adaptive-batching canary: 2024-06-24, open beta 4 weeks after. planning canary on a small fleet; will publish a sample route and node script.
Trevor: infra notes: Dedicated customers with pinned models need a migration toggle; infra will run load tests 2024-06-22 and 2024-06-21 evening. will post results in eng-sre.
Ella: DevEx will prepare SDK snippets and a short "what changed" for the migration guide. need example config from Jamal.
Jamal: example SDK flag: `enable_adaptive_batching:true` and `batching:{max_latency_ms:15,min_batch:4}`. we'll add a blurb about ordering edge-cases.
Kevin: marketing: screenshots needed for console cost-per-route preview; who owns mock data?
Mira: Kevin/Ella own screenshots; Jamal to provide reproducible data by EOD tomorrow.
docs-bot: docs request: attach a sample token-profile.csv and a small route config to the canary ticket.
Ana: console per-route cost rollout target: internal preview 2024-07-15, public roll 2024-08-05. will surface "estimate" label and link to raw usage export.
Mira: retention question for Optimize canary?
Ella: Optimize team requests +30 to +45 days eval-log retention during canary to measure regressions; ops signed off if orgs opt-in. Trevor to create retention JIRA.
Trevor: noted. I'll open JIRA and tag eng-infra and security.
Mira: action items: (1) Jamal publish sample route + node script by 2024-06-18, (2) Kevin/Ella screenshots by 2024-06-26, (3) Trevor open retention JIRA by 2024-06-19, (4) Lin prepare tooltip copy for "estimate" by 2024-07-10.
Jamal: one more technical note: no token-semantics change but batching can affect request ordering in rare cases; we'll add migration guidance.
Ana: I'll coordinate the announcement once owners confirm readiness.
Mira: thanks everyone. I'll compile a short post-all-hands summary and link back to this thread. :thumbsup:
